representation_notes: λ is the integer l; nonnegative exponents are Nat and I is Fin (l.toNat+1), identified with 0≤i≤λ using H002. V is an arbitrary complex module; x,y,h are its linear action endomorphisms. H003 records the sl₂ Chevalley relations, highest weight and complex irreducibility. M is an arbitrary Submodule ℤ V, equivalently an additive subgroup, with the integer/complex basis and divided-power stability in H005. R is the rational subring generated by inverses of integers not divisible by p; T006 proves it is exactly the specified ℤ_(p). Scalar actions use its inclusion R→ℚ→ℂ. MR is the actual R⊗ℤ M; its image L is used only through the checked iota in T006/T008. J is the coefficient submodule defined by membership in L. VK=K⊗ℤ M uses the tensor commutor identification with the source M⊗ℤ K. Operators are the actual scalar extensions of compatible integral endomorphisms; existence is proved, and compatible lifts are unique. Red=ZMod p⊗ℤ MR is identified with MR/pMR by T018, and FK is its extension to K. RK and FK install only canonical scalar actions internally. matrixUnit B i j sends B j to B i and other basis vectors to zero; multiplication of endomorphisms is composition with the right factor acting first. No Audit A note is a premise, verified Lean theorem or instance assumption; the two M declarations are used directly from pinned Mathlib.

steps.statement:
((l.toNat : ℤ) = l) ∧
(∀ i : Ix l, 0 ≤ (i.val : ℤ) ∧ (i.val : ℤ) ≤ l) ∧
(∀ i : ℤ, 0 ≤ i → i ≤ l → ∃ j : Ix l, (j.val : ℤ) = i) ∧
((0 < l.toNat + 1 ∧ Fintype.card (Ix l) = l.toNat + 1) ∧
(∀ t : ℕ, h ((y ^ t) v) = ((l - 2 * (t : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) • ((y ^ t) v)) ∧
(∀ t : ℕ, 0 < t → x ((y ^ t) v) = (((t : ℤ) * (l - (t : ℤ) + 1) : ℤ) : ℂ) • ((y ^ (t - 1)) v)))
steps.explanation: Check the explicit identification Fin(l.toNat+1)↔{i:ℤ | 0≤i≤l} under H002, including l.toNat=l. Then perform the supplied simultaneous induction on nonnegative lowering exponents with the complex commutators.

steps.statement: ∀ i : Ix l, ev y v i.val ≠ 0 ∧ h (ev y v i.val) = ((l - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) • ev y v i.val
steps.explanation: Iterate the raising identity to a nonzero factorial times falling product; retain the complex weight formula.

steps.statement: ∃ B : Module.Basis (Ix l) ℂ V, ∀ i, B i = ev y v i.val
steps.explanation: Separate distinct complex weights with the displayed polynomial in h, then use finite dimension to obtain the basis. No eigenvalue argument in characteristic p.

steps.statement: (∀ t : ℕ, l.toNat + 1 ≤ t → (y ^ t) v = 0) ∧ genFormulas l x y h (fun i : Ix l => ev y v i.val)
steps.explanation: Expand y^(λ+1)v in the complex basis using T001 and T003; distinct complex weights force it and all higher lowering powers to vanish. Normalize the positive-exponent raising/lowering identities by factorials. For the separate zero-exponent endpoint, ev y v 0=v by definition and H004 supplies x v=0, giving x e₀=0; T001's raising identity is guarded by 0<t and is not used at t=0. Thus every case of genFormulas has an explicit allowed input. This restores the existing highest-vector base condition at the T004 worker boundary; no premise, definition, target or source proof is changed.

steps.statement:
(((l.toNat : ℤ) = l) ∧
(∀ i : Ix l, 0 ≤ (i.val : ℤ) ∧ (i.val : ℤ) ≤ l) ∧
(∀ i : ℤ, 0 ≤ i → i ≤ l → ∃ j : Ix l, (j.val : ℤ) = i) ∧
((0 < l.toNat + 1 ∧ Fintype.card (Ix l) = l.toNat + 1) ∧
(∀ t : ℕ, h ((y ^ t) v) = ((l - 2 * (t : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) • ((y ^ t) v)) ∧
(∀ t : ℕ, 0 < t → x ((y ^ t) v) = (((t : ℤ) * (l - (t : ℤ) + 1) : ℤ) : ℂ) • ((y ^ (t - 1)) v)))) ∧ (∀ i : Ix l, ev y v i.val ≠ 0 ∧ h (ev y v i.val) = ((l - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ) • ev y v i.val) ∧ (∃ B : Module.Basis (Ix l) ℂ V, ∀ i, B i = ev y v i.val) ∧ ((∀ t : ℕ, l.toNat + 1 ≤ t → (y ^ t) v = 0) ∧ genFormulas l x y h (fun i : Ix l => ev y v i.val)) ∧ ((∀ (i : Ix l) (r : ℕ), divided x r (ev y v i.val) =
  if r ≤ i.val then ((Nat.choose (l.toNat - i.val + r) r : ℕ) : ℂ) • ev y v (i.val - r) else 0) ∧
(∀ (i : Ix l) (r : ℕ), divided y r (ev y v i.val) =
  if i.val + r ≤ l.toNat then ((Nat.choose (i.val + r) r : ℕ) : ℂ) • ev y v (i.val + r) else 0))
steps.explanation: Export N001 in full, iterating the generator formulas and dividing by factorials to obtain the integer binomial coefficients, including all zero cases.

steps.statement:
(∀ q : ℚ, q ∈ scalarRing p ↔ ∃ a b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)) ∧ ((∃ ι : MR p M →ₗ[R p] V, iotaSpec p M ι ∧ Function.Injective ι ∧ LinearMap.range ι = L p M) ∧
Nonempty (Module.Basis (Ix l) (R p) (MR p M)) ∧
Submodule.span ℂ (M : Set V) = ⊤ ∧
(∀ r : ℕ, Preserves M (divided x r) ∧ Preserves M (divided y r)) ∧
Preserves M x ∧ Preserves M y ∧ Preserves M h ∧
(∀ r : ℕ, (∀ u ∈ L p M, divided x r u ∈ L p M) ∧ (∀ u ∈ L p M, divided y r u ∈ L p M)) ∧
(∀ u ∈ L p M, x u ∈ L p M ∧ y u ∈ L p M ∧ h u ∈ L p M) ∧
(∃ fx fy fh : Module.End ℤ M, LiftOf M x fx ∧ LiftOf M y fy ∧ LiftOf M h fh) ∧
(∃ DX DY : ℕ → Module.End ℤ M, ∀ r, LiftOf M (divided x r) (DX r) ∧ LiftOf M (divided y r) (DY r)))
steps.explanation: Identify the inverse-generated rational subring with ℤ_(p). Extend an integer lattice basis to R, construct the pure-tensor iota and prove injectivity and span. Construct compatible integral operator lifts; no lift is an extra parameter or premise.

steps.statement:
∀ (B : Module.Basis (Ix l) ℂ V), (∀ i, B i = ev y v i.val) →
  (divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat = matrixUnit B (Fin.last l.toNat) (Fin.last l.toNat)) ∧
  (∀ i : Ix l, divided x (l.toNat - i.val) * (divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat) = matrixUnit B i (Fin.last l.toNat)) ∧
  (∀ j : Ix l, (divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat) * divided y (l.toNat - j.val) =
    ((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℕ) : ℂ) • matrixUnit B (Fin.last l.toNat) j) ∧
  (∀ j : Ix l, IsUnit ((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℕ) : R p))
steps.explanation: Evaluate the three matrix-unit factors on the complex basis. The prime bound makes binomial(λ,j) a unit in R. Endomorphism multiplication is composition, rightmost factor acts first.

steps.statement:
(∀ q : ℚ, q ∈ scalarRing p ↔ ∃ a b : ℤ, ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b ∧ q = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ)) ∧ (((∃ ι : MR p M →ₗ[R p] V, iotaSpec p M ι ∧ Function.Injective ι ∧ LinearMap.range ι = L p M) ∧
Nonempty (Module.Basis (Ix l) (R p) (MR p M)) ∧
Submodule.span ℂ (M : Set V) = ⊤ ∧
(∀ r : ℕ, Preserves M (divided x r) ∧ Preserves M (divided y r)) ∧
Preserves M x ∧ Preserves M y ∧ Preserves M h ∧
(∀ r : ℕ, (∀ u ∈ L p M, divided x r u ∈ L p M) ∧ (∀ u ∈ L p M, divided y r u ∈ L p M)) ∧
(∀ u ∈ L p M, x u ∈ L p M ∧ y u ∈ L p M ∧ h u ∈ L p M) ∧
(∃ fx fy fh : Module.End ℤ M, LiftOf M x fx ∧ LiftOf M y fy ∧ LiftOf M h fh) ∧
(∃ DX DY : ℕ → Module.End ℤ M, ∀ r, LiftOf M (divided x r) (DX r) ∧ LiftOf M (divided y r) (DY r))) ∧ (∀ (B : Module.Basis (Ix l) ℂ V), (∀ i, B i = ev y v i.val) →
  (divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat = matrixUnit B (Fin.last l.toNat) (Fin.last l.toNat)) ∧
  (∀ i : Ix l, divided x (l.toNat - i.val) * (divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat) = matrixUnit B i (Fin.last l.toNat)) ∧
  (∀ j : Ix l, (divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat) * divided y (l.toNat - j.val) =
    ((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℕ) : ℂ) • matrixUnit B (Fin.last l.toNat) j) ∧
  (∀ j : Ix l, IsUnit ((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℕ) : R p))) ∧ (∀ (B : Module.Basis (Ix l) ℂ V), (∀ i, B i = ev y v i.val) →
  ∀ i j : Ix l,
  matrixUnit B i j = (((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹) •
    (divided x (l.toNat - i.val) * (divided y l.toNat * divided x l.toNat) * divided y (l.toNat - j.val)) ∧
  ∀ u ∈ L p M, matrixUnit B i j u ∈ L p M))
steps.explanation: Compose the factor identities and use R-module closure to prove preservation by every matrix unit; collect N002. Also retain T006's identification of the rational subring as an implementation bridge reused in the rank and valuation calculations.

steps.statement: ∀ i : Ix l, J p M (ev y v i.val) = J p M (ev y v 0)
steps.explanation: Use preserving E_ij and E_ji to equate all coordinate coefficient modules.

steps.statement:
∃ s : (Ix l → J p M (ev y v 0)) ≃ₗ[R p] L p M,
  ∀ c, (s c : V) = ∑ i : Ix l, (c i : ℂ) • ev y v i.val
steps.explanation: Projection onto each e_i proves every coefficient is in J; finite coordinate sum and coordinate projection are inverse R-linear maps.

steps.statement:
(∀ i : Ix l, J p M (ev y v i.val) = J p M (ev y v 0)) ∧ (∃ s : (Ix l → J p M (ev y v 0)) ≃ₗ[R p] L p M,
  ∀ c, (s c : V) = ∑ i : Ix l, (c i : ℂ) • ev y v i.val) ∧ ((J p M (ev y v 0)).FG ∧ J p M (ev y v 0) ≠ ⊥)
steps.explanation: Project finite generators of M_R to obtain finite generation of J. Nonzero complex span excludes J=0. Retain the common-module equalities and explicit coordinate isomorphism as N003.

steps.statement:
(∃ μ : (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0)) →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ,
  (∀ (q : ℚ) (c : J p M (ev y v 0)), μ (q ⊗ₜ[R p] c) = (q : ℂ) * (c : ℂ)) ∧
  Function.Injective μ ∧ LinearMap.range μ = Submodule.span ℚ (J p M (ev y v 0) : Set ℂ)) ∧ (Module.Finite ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0)))
steps.explanation: Define tensor multiplication by R-balancing, combine tensors using a common denominator, and prove injectivity. Images of finite generators give finite-dimensionality.

steps.statement: Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0)) = 1
steps.explanation: Use the pinned Module.finrank_baseChange (both coefficient rings satisfy StrongRankCondition, and the source module is free) and Module.finrank_pi_fintype (finite index, every factor free and finite) directly. R is a subring of ℚ, so both rings are domains with strong rank condition. N002 supplies an R-basis; T012 makes QJ finite-dimensional over ℚ, hence free and finite. Tensor the N003 coordinate isomorphism, obtain n=n*r and r=1 since n>0. No M premise port or flatness assumption is needed.

steps.statement:
∃ a : ℂ, a ∈ J p M (ev y v 0) ∧ a ≠ 0 ∧
 ∃ k : ℕ, 0 < k ∧ ∃ g : Fin k → ℂ,
 (∀ j, g j ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ q : ℚ, q ≠ 0 ∧ g j = (q : ℂ) * a) ∧
 Submodule.span (R p) (Set.range g) = J p M (ev y v 0)
steps.explanation: Choose a nonzero element and a finite nonempty list of nonzero generators. Rank one gives rational coordinates of every generator, rather than inferring rational rank from containment in ℂ.

steps.statement: ∃ b : ℂ, b ∈ J p M (ev y v 0) ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ J p M (ev y v 0) = Submodule.span (R p) {b}
steps.explanation: Strip p factors from rational numerators and denominators, take the minimum of the finitely many integer exponents, and prove both inclusions J=Rb. Preserve this valuation argument rather than replacing it with a different classification proof.

steps.statement:
(∃ μ : (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0)) →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ,
  (∀ (q : ℚ) (c : J p M (ev y v 0)), μ (q ⊗ₜ[R p] c) = (q : ℂ) * (c : ℂ)) ∧
  Function.Injective μ ∧ LinearMap.range μ = Submodule.span ℚ (J p M (ev y v 0) : Set ℂ)) ∧ (Module.finrank ℚ (ℚ ⊗[R p] J p M (ev y v 0)) = 1) ∧ (∃ b : ℂ, b ∈ J p M (ev y v 0) ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ J p M (ev y v 0) = Submodule.span (R p) {b}) ∧ (∀ b : ℂ, b ∈ J p M (ev y v 0) → b ≠ 0 →
  J p M (ev y v 0) = Submodule.span (R p) {b} →
  ∃ B : Module.Basis (Ix l) (R p) (L p M), ∀ i, (B i : V) = b • ev y v i.val)
steps.explanation: The principal coefficient module and complex independence produce the R-basis (b e_i) for every eligible b. Transport through injective iota when using the actual tensor M_R. Export N004 including tensor multiplication and rank.

steps.statement:
∀ [hc : CharP K p], ∃ κ : R p →+* K,
 (∀ (a b : ℤ) (r : R p), (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ) → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b →
    κ r = (a : K) * (b : K)⁻¹) ∧
 ∃ C : RK κ M ≃ₗ[K] VK K M, canonicalR κ M C ∧
 (∀ (f : Module.End ℤ M) (w : RK κ M),
    C (throughR κ f w) = f.baseChange K (C w)) ∧
 ∃ D : FK p K M ≃ₗ[K] VK K M, canonicalF κ M D ∧
 (∀ (f : Module.End ℤ M) (w : FK p K M),
    D (throughF p K f w) = f.baseChange K (D w))
steps.explanation: Construct κ by fractions and both natural tensor isomorphisms with explicit pure-tensor values. Prove all integral lattice endomorphisms intertwine. FK uses ZMod p⊗MR as the quotient model, with the quotient bridge recorded separately in T018.

steps.statement:
∃ q : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] Red p M,
 (∀ u, q u = (1 : ZMod p) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] u) ∧
 Function.Surjective q ∧ LinearMap.ker q = (pPart p M).restrictScalars ℤ
steps.explanation: Prove the canonical map MR→ZMod p⊗ℤ MR is onto with kernel pMR. This is the checked bridge between the tensor quotient model Red and MR/pMR; the induced quotient equivalence is ZMod p-linear via its canonical quotient action.

steps.statement:
(∀ fx fy fh : Module.End ℤ M,
 LiftOf M x fx → LiftOf M y fy → LiftOf M h fh → ∃ β : Module.Basis (Ix l) K (VK K M),
 basisOrigin M y v β ∧ genFormulas l (fx.baseChange K) (fy.baseChange K) (fh.baseChange K) β) ∧ Module.finrank K (VK K M) = l.toNat + 1 ∧ Nontrivial (VK K M)
steps.explanation: Choose b from N004, transport its R-basis through iota and the canonical tensor map, then extend coordinate maps to K. Retain basis provenance and all three reduced generator formulas; obtain dimension and nonzero space.

steps.statement:
((∃ fx fy fh : Module.End ℤ M, LiftOf M x fx ∧ LiftOf M y fy ∧ LiftOf M h fh) ∧
(∃ DX DY : ℕ → Module.End ℤ M, ∀ r, LiftOf M (divided x r) (DX r) ∧ LiftOf M (divided y r) (DY r))) ∧ ((∀ [hc : CharP K p], ∃ κ : R p →+* K,
 (∀ (a b : ℤ) (r : R p), (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / (b : ℚ) → ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ b →
    κ r = (a : K) * (b : K)⁻¹) ∧
 ∃ C : RK κ M ≃ₗ[K] VK K M, canonicalR κ M C ∧
 (∀ (f : Module.End ℤ M) (w : RK κ M),
    C (throughR κ f w) = f.baseChange K (C w)) ∧
 ∃ D : FK p K M ≃ₗ[K] VK K M, canonicalF κ M D ∧
 (∀ (f : Module.End ℤ M) (w : FK p K M),
    D (throughF p K f w) = f.baseChange K (D w))) ∧ (∃ q : MR p M →ₗ[ℤ] Red p M,
 (∀ u, q u = (1 : ZMod p) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] u) ∧
 Function.Surjective q ∧ LinearMap.ker q = (pPart p M).restrictScalars ℤ) ∧ ((∀ fx fy fh : Module.End ℤ M,
 LiftOf M x fx → LiftOf M y fy → LiftOf M h fh → ∃ β : Module.Basis (Ix l) K (VK K M),
 basisOrigin M y v β ∧ genFormulas l (fx.baseChange K) (fy.baseChange K) (fh.baseChange K) β) ∧ Module.finrank K (VK K M) = l.toNat + 1 ∧ Nontrivial (VK K M)) ∧ (∀ fx fy fh : Module.End ℤ M,
 LiftOf M x fx → LiftOf M y fy → LiftOf M h fh →
 ∀ DX DY : ℕ → Module.End ℤ M,
 (∀ r, LiftOf M (divided x r) (DX r) ∧ LiftOf M (divided y r) (DY r)) →
 ∃ β : Module.Basis (Ix l) K (VK K M),
 basisOrigin M y v β ∧ genFormulas l (fx.baseChange K) (fy.baseChange K) (fh.baseChange K) β ∧
 (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ l.toNat → (r.factorial : K) ≠ 0 ∧
   (DX r).baseChange K = (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • (fx.baseChange K)^r ∧
   (DY r).baseChange K = (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • (fy.baseChange K)^r) ∧
 (∀ j : Ix l, ((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℕ) : K) ≠ 0) ∧
 (∀ i j : Ix l, matrixUnit β i j =
  (((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℕ) : K)⁻¹) •
  ((DX (l.toNat - i.val)).baseChange K *
    ((DY l.toNat).baseChange K * (DX l.toNat).baseChange K) *
    (DY (l.toNat - j.val)).baseChange K)) ∧
 (∀ i j k : Ix l, matrixUnit β i j (β k) = if j = k then β i else 0)))
steps.explanation: Reduce the original matrix-unit identity on the chosen basis. Factorials up to λ are nonzero in arbitrary K of characteristic p, hence the lattice divided powers become inverse-factorial ordinary powers. Collect the tensor maps, quotient bridge, basis provenance and full N005.

steps.statement:
∀ fx fy fh : Module.End ℤ M,
 LiftOf M x fx → LiftOf M y fy → LiftOf M h fh → ∀ DX DY : ℕ → Module.End ℤ M,
 (∀ r, LiftOf M (divided x r) (DX r) ∧ LiftOf M (divided y r) (DY r)) →
 ∀ β : Module.Basis (Ix l) K (VK K M),
 (∀ i j : Ix l, matrixUnit β i j =
  (((Nat.choose l.toNat j.val : ℕ) : K)⁻¹) •
   ((DX (l.toNat - i.val)).baseChange K * ((DY l.toNat).baseChange K * (DX l.toNat).baseChange K) * (DY (l.toNat - j.val)).baseChange K)) →
 (∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ l.toNat →
   (DX r).baseChange K = (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • (fx.baseChange K)^r ∧
   (DY r).baseChange K = (r.factorial : K)⁻¹ • (fy.baseChange K)^r) →
 ∀ W : Submodule K (VK K M),
 Stable W (fx.baseChange K) → Stable W (fy.baseChange K) → Stable W (fh.baseChange K) →
 ∀ i j : Ix l, Stable W (matrixUnit β i j)
steps.explanation: An x,y,h-stable K-subspace is stable under powers, scalar multiples and compositions; substitute the reduced divided-power matrix-unit factorization.

steps.statement:
∀ β : Module.Basis (Ix l) K (VK K M), ∀ W : Submodule K (VK K M),
 (∀ i j : Ix l, Stable W (matrixUnit β i j)) → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤
steps.explanation: For a nonzero W choose w, its basis coefficients, and a nonzero coefficient jointly. Apply matrix units and divide by that coefficient to put every basis vector in W. Include the zero case and discharge all temporary choices.

steps.statement:
Nontrivial (VK K M) ∧
 (∃ fx fy fh : Module.End ℤ M, LiftOf M x fx ∧ LiftOf M y fy ∧ LiftOf M h fh) ∧
 (∀ fx fy fh : Module.End ℤ M,
 LiftOf M x fx → LiftOf M y fy → LiftOf M h fh → SimpleTriple (fx.baseChange K) (fy.baseChange K) (fh.baseChange K))
steps.explanation: Choose compatible lattice lifts and divided-power lifts supplied by N002; apply N005 and the matrix-unit invariance argument. Quantify over every compatible triple (unique by subtype injectivity) and include nonzero V_K. This states exactly invariance under the Chevalley action, also in characteristic 2.
